selection_rationale: CatBoost selected in the 2R retrain on the accumulated corpus. 2R grouped 5-fold CV: recall 0.9861 (+/-0.0080), precision 0.8924 (+/-0.0129), F1 0.9369 - best individual CV F1 (RF 0.9327, XGBoost 0.9263, LightGBM 0.9183). Validation @0.5: F1 0.9645, precision 0.9386, recall 0.9920, PR-AUC 0.9976, confusion tn=879 fp=65 fn=8 tp=993 - the strongest precision among the leaders while comfortably meeting the deployment policy at the default threshold. RandomForest (the 1R selection) was fifth of six by validation PR-AUC in 2R (0.9958) with the worst tree-model FP count (88); per the pre-registered decision rule the selection was re-made on validation. The stacking ensemble WON validation F1 (0.9722, +0.0077) - a real gain unlike 1R's noise-level tie - but was not retained: the custom GroupedStackingClassifier cannot be explained by shap.TreeExplainer, and per-URL SHAP evidence is the platform's core feature; it also costs four base models and ~14x the fit time. SELECTION NOTE (discipline): an initial 2R finalize with RandomForest was run and its one-time test consumed (F1 0.9053, recall 0.9827) before the selection correction; that run is retained in model_metrics.csv history. The correction to CatBoost was decided on VALIDATION results only (visible in the Phase 2 comparison before any test evaluation); the RF test numbers were not used for this choice.

calibration.no_domain_overlap: train and validation share no registrable domains
calibration.caveat: calibrator and threshold both use the validation split; the sigmoid adds 2 parameters so in-sample optimism on the validation rows is negligible; the test split was never used for calibration or threshold selection
calibration.note: raw model scores are scores, not probabilities; only calibrated outputs are reported as probabilities

feature_set.tfidf: char (3,5)-gram TF-IDF fitted on training data only

one_time_discipline: test.csv evaluated exactly once per run; forced re-runs (--force) overwrite and re-stamp
